core_principles: Fixed Costs vs Variable Costs: Fixed costs (rent, equipment depreciation) must be decoupled from Variable costs (raw materials, packaging).
Gross Margin Percentage: Target minimum 45% gross margin for packaged micro-goods and 60% for fresh impulse hot items.
Breakeven Calculation: Monthly Breakeven Sales Volume = (Monthly Fixed Overheads) / (Selling Price per Unit - Variable Cost per Unit).
Working Capital Cycle: Maintain 15-day cash cushion for raw material procurement from local APMC Mandis to prevent stockouts.

Tiered Pack Pricing (Price Discrimination): Serve 3 distinct customer segments with 3 pack tiers: 100g impulse (high margin), 250g retail pouch (wholesale distribution to local Kirana shops), 1kg bulk box (catering/events).
Competitor Saturation & Differentiation: In a 5-10 km radius with existing micro-units, compete on fresh daily batch production and direct APMC Mandi raw material sourcing rather than price cutting.
Distribution Channel Velocity: Build a 15-shop retail Kirana distribution network offering 20-25% retailer margin to gain shelf space.
